resources.string: Reads the address shown by browsers to block adult sites and masks explicit images on screen. Nothing is stored or sent: everything happens on the phone.
Adult content blocker, locked in time
USB debugging stays on: a PC can remove PrP. Do not use it for the real lock.
Deadline reached: you can request exit.
Tap a red line to see how to fix it.
PrP must become the device owner. Follow the “Strong mode: setup” card (no PC, Android 11 and newer), or run tools/installer-android.bat from a PC.
The guard reads browser addresses to block adult sites. Turn it on with the button below.
To restart its guard by itself, PrP needs a permission granted during Strong mode setup.
The family DNS filters adult sites across the whole phone. It is applied when you lock.
Factory reset, safe mode, adding users and changing DNS are blocked when you lock, so PrP cannot be bypassed.
The detection model loads when the guard starts. If it stays red, open “Details” in the Image detection card.
The family DNS resolvers are unreachable on this network: PrP left DNS on automatic so as not to cut the Internet, and retries every minute.
Turn on “PrP – Guard” in accessibility settings.
Meanwhile, browser filtering works, but it can be turned off.

Blurs the whole image or video as soon as it shows nudity: genitals, bare buttocks, bare breasts. Swimsuits, underwear and bare chests stay visible. The blur follows the image when you scroll. Everything is analysed on the phone: no image is stored or sent.
Requires Android 11 or newer. Site blocking still works.
While locked, detection stays on and sensitivity can only become stricter.
black or protected screen: not analysed
Masks show up in this phone\'s screenshots. Blurred images stay in place; only areas with no recognised image disappear for an instant every 2 seconds to re-check the screen.
The mask does not show up in screenshots (ideal case).
Not measured yet (it happens at the first mask).
Also blurs bare chests, swimsuits and underwear. While locked, it can be turned on but not off.
Before this deadline, nothing and no one can remove PrP.
Wait between your exit request and the actual exit.
No going back before the deadline, then %1$s of cooling-off. The phone\'s clock does not matter: only real elapsed time counts.
After the deadline you can request exit. It becomes possible %1$s later.
Cancel the request and stay protected
The new duration counts from now. The lock is never shortened, and a pending exit request is cancelled.

PrP %1$s

Detection models: NSFWJS MobileNetV2 (MIT), Marqo nsfw-image-detection-384 (Apache 2.0).
Icons: Material Icons (Apache 2.0).
Site lists: The Block List Project (Unlicense), Université Toulouse Capitole UT1 (CC BY-SA 4.0).
Trusted time: drand (League of Entropy).
Setup without a PC: Shizuku API (MIT).
Choose how PrP protects this phone. You can change it as long as the lock is not set.
PrP becomes the owner of the phone. Guided setup on the phone, no PC needed, in 5 to 10 minutes.
PrP becomes the owner of the phone. On this phone, setup is done once from a PC.
Softer protection. Set up in one minute.
PrP uses the free Shizuku app and Android\'s “Wireless debugging” to become the owner of the phone, just as a PC would. Once it is the owner, PrP cannot be removed before the lock deadline.
Without a PC, Strong mode requires Android 11 or newer. On this phone, run tools/installer-android.bat from a PC, or choose Simple mode.
Shizuku is a free app that lets PrP do from the phone what a PC would do over a cable.

1. Settings › About phone: tap “Build number” 7 times to show developer options.\n2. Open Shizuku, tap “Pairing” under “Start via Wireless debugging”, then follow its instructions (pairing code).\n3. Tap “Start” in Shizuku, then come back to PrP.
Tap the button below, then “Allow” in the Shizuku window.

Android only accepts an owner if the phone has no account. PrP itself removes, for a few seconds, the apps that have an account, then puts them back with their data. Only Google accounts must be removed by hand: you can add them back right after.
Tap the button: PrP does the rest in a few seconds. Afterwards you can add your Google accounts back and turn off wireless debugging.
PrP is the owner of the phone. You can add your accounts back.
In accessibility settings, open “PrP – Guard” and turn it on. It reads browser addresses; nothing is stored or sent.
If Android says “Restricted setting”: open PrP\'s app info, tap ⋮ at the top right, then “Allow restricted settings”, and try again.
This right prevents uninstalling PrP with a single tap.
PrP needs this so it cannot be uninstalled during the lock.
All set: you can choose the lock duration below.
Prevents uninstalling PrP with a single tap. Turn it on from the setup card.
